description:
The Bantam is specially designed to fit little people with inseams down to 16 inches – custom built to fit perfectly and give the best quality ride. It also folds to fit in a car trunk or an airline check-able suitcase for international adventures. Hand made in Oregon, USA.. Base model weight starts at 22lbs.

The Bantam is designed to give people of shorter stature, with inseams from 16 to 23 in, the option to own a high performance bike that fit their bodies. There are very few bike options for people with shorter inseams so often adults must resort to riding children’s bikes. At Bike Friday we believe everyone deserves to ride a high performance bike that fits them.

The Bantam’s ability to fold in 30 seconds allows you to put it into a car trunk, train seat, small ship cabin, or, with a little disassembly, pack it into an airline check-able suitcase for travel. Zero proprietary parts make it easy to maintain.

We offer you many custom options, then hand build your bike to fit your size and particular riding plans. All Bantams feature 9 speed drivetrains, V-brakes, shorter cranks, smaller 16″ wheels and lower stand-over than our other Pocket Bikes.

components.description: Quick folds to fit into a car trunk or small space. Will also disassemble to fit into a standard airline check-able Samsonite suitcase. 31 x 21 x 12” (varies slightly with frame size and component selections)
Wide 24mm+ 406mm rims, hand laced 3-cross to 36 hole hubs
